features.feature: Today greets by the time of day and About me's first name, with the date, the meetings, the tasks on the user and how many are late

Your day lists today's accepted meetings and calls in time order with the line "now"; each shows its threads and minutes state (New minutes with what they hold, Minutes, Writing, Minutes at HH:MM, Minutes failed + Try again), Show prep / Prepare, Record when it starts / Don't record, Import Teams transcript

My work · this week lists the tasks due by the week's end or late (late first) with whose they are, a date icon and the thread; a card opens its details; its icons close it (asking first) or open the Claude dialog

Needs you now lists what waits on the user from Teams and mail in the last 24 h (burning first), with Reply in Teams / Read and reply, I'll do it (a task in a thread), Won't do: Reply with Teams' logo or an envelope, the others icons, each named in its label and tooltip
Cards sent to Today by routines or plugins show until Got it
A day with nothing says "A quiet day"; ⌘K on Today acts on its items
